familyRule.reason: Same family, newer generation, same or lower cost class, reasoning ladder preserved.

migrations.reason: Token Economy rates Sonnet 5 as the better value tier for bounded supporting work. Leaving the Haiku family is a cost decision, not a family rule, so it is offered and never applied automatically.
codex-cli rejects gpt-5-codex on a ChatGPT account with a 400 invalid_request (AGT-1941). API-key accounts still accept it, so the switch stays operator-confirmed.
